about_the_game: VRC Pro is the ultimate radio controlled (r/c) car racing simulator, featuring electric and nitro on-road classes, 1:10 short course trucks, 1:8 nitro and electric buggies and Rally-X. Bashing and crawling with the Stadium truck. And  even 1:10 scale electric drifting! Practiced mode with opponents, on-line racing events and multi-player mode. Race anyone in the world in our on-line competitions and multi-player sessions!

These 2 exciting 'compact' off-road tracks offer a great dirt racing experience for our short course trucks, stadium trucks and nitro and electric buggies!
